name: Shikigami
source:
Main character is an occult enthusiast. He finds three types of bills in his old warehouse - red, blue and green. In an attempt to defend school from a mysterious beast he learns that these bills can summon shikigami. Each of spirits appears in the form of a girl and demands a part of protagonist as payment. Body fluid also suffices, so his sex life becomes much more diverse. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
